map.菌落总数按 GB 4789.2 平板计数法：选取菌落数在 30 至 300 之间: The aerobic plate count follows the GB 4789.2 plate count method: take plates with colony counts between 30 and 300, and aerobic plate count = plate colony count × dilution factor ÷ sample volume; when plates at two adjacent dilutions both fall in the counting range they are combined with the weighted formula, and the result is reported in CFU/g or CFU/mL to two significant figures.

map.报告结果 = 平板平均菌落数 × 稀释倍数（按 GB 4789.2 选取有效稀释: Report result = mean plate colony count × dilution factor, taking the valid dilution per GB 4789.2.
map.某稀释度平均 156、稀释 10⁻¹：报告结果 = 156×10 = 1560: A mean of 156 at a dilution of 10⁻¹ gives a reported result of 156 × 10 = 1560 CFU/g; generating five sample reports applies each sample mean and dilution in turn.
map.取 30–300 菌落平板对应稀释度；多稀释度按加权或取主稀释度，方法须前后一致: Take the dilution whose plate shows 30–300 colonies; with several dilutions use weighting or the main dilution, and keep the method consistent throughout.
